home.title: Safe from Harm
home.subtitle: An online learning course for Scout Moot 2026 participants.
home.intro: Learn how to recognise harm, respond safely, and help every participant feel safe at the Moot. The course is free, takes about 20–30 minutes, and works on a phone.
home.whatIntro: Short, practical modules with videos, questions and a space to reflect. SAMPLE content is shown until the official material is published.
home.learn1Body: Notice the signs of unsafe situations, harassment and exploitation.
home.learn2Body: Take appropriate action while keeping yourself and others safe.
home.learn3Body: Know how to raise a concern quickly with the right person.
home.how1Body: No password needed. Register with your Scout ID and a phone number or email.
home.how2Body: Watch each module video, answer the questions and write a short reflection. Your progress saves automatically.
home.how3Body: Complete every step and download a verifiable certificate with a QR code.
home.sampleBody: The three modules currently in this course are SAMPLE placeholders. They must be replaced with official Bangladesh Scouts Safe from Harm content before launch. Nothing here is official policy text.
home.privacyBody: We collect only what is needed to run the course and issue a certificate. Reflection answers are encrypted at rest and can only be read by designated safeguarding staff.
home.ctaBody: Keep your Scout ID nearby. Registration takes about two minutes.

register.title: Register
register.subtitle: Fill in the details below to start the course.
register.privacyBody: We collect your name, Scout ID, unit, district, member type and one contact method (phone or email) to run this course and issue a certificate. Your reflection answers are sensitive: they are encrypted at rest and can only be read by designated safeguarding staff. We do not publish your personal data. Certificate verification shows only your English name, the course, the issue date and validity. To correct or delete your data, contact the safeguarding contact.
register.consent: I agree to my data being used as described in the privacy notice.
register.guardianLabel: My parent or guardian has consented to my participation.
register.nameEnHint: Latin characters only (A–Z), spaces, dots and hyphens. This is printed on your certificate.
register.scoutIdHint: Your Scout ID must be unique. Example: BD-123456.
register.contactHint: Provide at least one. We will only use it for course-related contact.
